title: Peacock in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail fan feathers -->
  <g>
    <!-- outer feathers -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="38" ry="30" fill="#1b8a5a"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="34" ry="26" fill="#22b573"/>
    <!-- individual eye feathers -->
    <ellipse cx="28" cy="24" rx="8" ry="10" fill="#2ed47a" transform="rotate(-30 28 24)"/>
    <ellipse cx="72" cy="24" rx="8" ry="10" fill="#2ed47a" transform="rotate(30 72 24)"/>
    <ellipse cx="20" cy="40" rx="8" ry="10" fill="#2ed47a" transform="rotate(-50 20 40)"/>
    <ellipse cx="80" cy="40" rx="8" ry="10" fill="#2ed47a" transform="rotate(50 80 40)"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="16" rx="8" ry="10" fill="#2ed47a"/>
    <!-- feather eyes -->
    <circle cx="28" cy="22" r="4" fill="#1f4fd8"/>
    <circle cx="28" cy="22" r="2" fill="#ffd23f"/>
    <circle cx="72" cy="22" r="4" fill="#1f4fd8"/>
    <circle cx="72" cy="22" r="2" fill="#ffd23f"/>
    <circle cx="20" cy="38" r="4" fill="#1f4fd8"/>
    <circle cx="20" cy="38" r="2" fill="#ffd23f"/>
    <circle cx="80" cy="38" r="4" fill="#1f4fd8"/>
    <circle cx="80" cy="38" r="2" fill="#ffd23f"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="14" r="4" fill="#1f4fd8"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="14" r="2" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  </g>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="16" ry="20" fill="#2071c9"/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="10" ry="12" fill="#3f9df0"/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x="44" y="50" width="12" height="16" rx="5" fill="#2071c9"/>
  <rect x="47" y="52" width="4" height="12" rx="2" fill="#3f9df0"/>

  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d="M38 58 Q50 64 62 58 L61 64 Q50 70 39 64 Z" fill="#e8452b"/>
  <path d="M58 62 L64 76 L58 75 L54 63 Z" fill="#e8452b"/>
  <path d="M59 66 L63 76 L60 75.5 L57 66 Z" fill="#ff6b52"/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <path d="M41 61 Q50 66 59 61 L59 63 Q50 68 41 63 Z" fill="#ffd23f"/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="47" r="10" fill="#2071c9"/>
  <!-- face lighter patch -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="46" r="6" fill="#3f9df0"/>

  <!-- crest -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="38" r="2.5" fill="#2ed47a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="36" r="2.5" fill="#2ed47a"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="38" r="2.5" fill="#2ed47a"/>
  <line x1="44" y1="40" x2="44" y2="38" stroke="#22b573" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="38" x2="50" y2="36" stroke="#22b573" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="56" y1="40" x2="56" y2="38" stroke="#22b573" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- beak -->
  <path d="M60 46 L68 48 L60 50 Z" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="48" x2="67" y2="48" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx="55" cy="44" r="2.2" fill="#1a1160"/>
  <circle cx="55.7" cy="43.4" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1="45" y1="86" x2="43" y2="95" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="86" x2="57" y2="95" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M38 95 L43 95 L45 98 M48 95 L43 95" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M52 95 L57 95 L60 98 M54 95 L57 95" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
</svg>
